note: Golden set for translation QUALITY — the thing this product is, and the
one thing nothing measured until v3.0.0.
Every item states MACHINE-CHECKABLE expectations, because those are the
ones that can regress silently and be scored without a human or a judge
model. They are not a taste test: they are the CONTRACT the prompts
promise — entity preservation, the date engine, the fixed credit labels,
the retired interjection, register, and Persian output at all.
Fluency is judged separately (run_eval.py --judge), because fluency is a
matter of degree and needs a reader; the contract is binary and needs a
test. Keeping them apart means a prompt change can be shown to have
improved style WITHOUT quietly breaking a ⟦n⟧ token.
CHECK KINDS
persian      output is actually Persian (ratio of Persian letters)
contains     substring must appear (use for fixed labels, Jalali dates)
absent       substring must NOT appear (retired words, leaked English)
regexp       pattern must match
keepLatin    every listed string survives character-for-character
tokens       every ⟦n⟧ placeholder appears exactly once
emojiCount   the same number of emoji as the source
linesEqual   the same number of line breaks as the source
unchanged    output equals input (already-Persian text)
